messages:
oliver_pm: Heads up — AWS marketplace seller onboarding stalled. Procurement flagged that the marketplace requires EFT remittance but the seller's bank verification keeps failing the marketplace checksum. They also raised a terms mismatch: marketplace requires marketplace-collects payments vs seller expects Redwood invoicing (NET30). Can ops/legal help triage?
sana_partnerops: :eyes: do we have the seller's marketplace ticket?
oliver_pm: marketplace support ticket `MP-984512` — snippet from them: 
```
Payment method: EFT failed validation (routing/account checksum)
Merchant prefers Redwood invoice flow (NET30). Marketplace settlement flow incompatible.
```
They suggest either seller updates bank wiring or we route via our billing account.
jamie_finance: Routing via Redwood billing is possible but needs approvals — that changes revenue recognition and requires a signed MSA addendum for payment collection. I'll need the legal ok and FP&A signoff.
tia_legal: Quick read: shifting collection to Redwood will require an amendment with specific indemnity and tax clauses. If seller insists on NET30 then marketplace onboarding won't go live until marketplace allows off-platform invoicing (rare). Can you share the seller's legal contact?
miguel_eng: From an infra perspective, if we collect payment we also need to flip the marketplace integration flag and provide invoice metadata in the Marketplace API payload. That's a small dev task but needs a config change and audit log.
sana_partnerops: Seller contact is `payments@edgeworks.com`. I've DM'd them to confirm whether they can re-submit bank details. If they can't, we should scope the collection route.
oliver_pm: I emailed payments@edgeworks.com and copied legal/finance. They replied: "We can resubmit bank details but their in-country bank does not have ACH-compatible routing; marketplace rejects non-ACH accounts." So likely can't fix on seller side.
jamie_finance: Ok — propose temporary workaround: Redwood performs upstream collection for first 3 months while we sort contract amendment. Need legal to draft a short addendum limited to payment routing + tax. Also need a signed PO from the buyer side if they want NET30.
tia_legal: I can draft an addendum template today, but we need to confirm signatory and whether Marketplace allows a connector that uses our billing identity. I'll ping the marketplace account manager.
marketplace_bot: Ticket `MP-984512` updated by AWS Support: "Escalated to Partner Payments team — awaiting confirmation on off-platform settlement feasibility."
oliver_pm: Action items: (1) tia_legal to draft payment addendum (2) jamie_finance to list accounting implications and temporary collection plan (3) sana_partnerops to keep seller engaged and confirm if any bank update is possible (4) miguel_eng to estimate code/config effort if we opt to collect.
sana_partnerops: I'll get seller on a 15-min call today.
miguel_eng: Estimate: 1 developer + 4 hours to add invoice metadata + feature flag; 1-2 hours ops change.
jamie_finance: Noted. I'll prepare the accounting impact doc and a one-page summary for FP&A approval.
tia_legal: Draft ETA 6 hours, I'll post here when done.
oliver_pm: Thanks all — please post updates in this thread. If marketplace says no to off-platform collection, we'll need to escalate to partnerships leadership for an exec exception. :handshake:
